Cc: monica.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Expanding to three more product teams — pricing / keys / timeline

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the demo last week — the engineers liked the latency and the cost profile you showed. We want to onboard three additional product teams (Search, Recommendations, and Support Chat) within the same account. High level asks from our side:

- Rough incremental monthly cost for ~4M tokens/day across the new teams (mixed generation + embeddings).
- Process for provisioning isolated API keys per team and expected lead time.
- Any term/commit impact if we add these teams now (we're approaching renewal in September).

Can you send a short plan (timeline + contacts) we can take into our internal procurement sync? Monica, looping you in to keep the commercial thread together.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Engineering — Simonsite

From: chloe.martin@redwoodai.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@simonsite.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodai.com, ben.carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding to three more product teams — pricing / keys / timeline

Samir — thanks for the note and glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front, then a proposed plan: \n
- Incremental cost: ballpark $18k–$26k/month depending on batching and model mix; I'll attach a simple cost scenario.
- API keys: we provision per-team namespaces (separate keys + rate limits). Typical lead time: 2 business days for staging keys, 5–7 business days for production keys if there are no compliance blockers.
- Term/commit: because your renewal is in Sept, adding committed capacity now lets us grandfather current unit pricing for the new teams through the next renewal cycle — we can scope a small addendum.

Proposed 3-step rollout (high level):
1) Quick staging: issue three staging keys and a shared test quota (2 days)
2) Pilot (2 weeks): each team runs a limited pilot and feeds back latency/cost observations
3) Prod provisioning & terms: production keys + optional committed capacity agreement (5–7 days)

I'll have Ben (CC) draft the commercial amendment and Monica will coordinate the procurement artifacts. Attaching a quick cost scenario.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Simonsite_Scope_v3.pdf (summary cost scenarios)

From: ben.carter@redwoodai.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@simonsite.com>, chloe.martin@redwoodai.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding to three more product teams — pricing / keys / timeline

Samir — adding some concrete commercial options so procurement has something to review quickly. I kept the options tight to avoid churn in internal approvals: 

Option A — Pay-as-you-go (no change to current renewal)
- No upfront commit; billed at usage rates. Estimated incremental: $26k/mo.

Option B — Short-term commit (3 months)
- 10% discount on token usage for the new teams for 3 months if committed to a $60k USD minimum spend across the 3 teams. Estimated: $20k/mo effective.

Option C — Addendum to current renewal (annual)
- Add the 3 teams under the September renewal schedule, lock current unit pricing for 12 months for the added capacity. Requires signed amendment and DocuSign.

Requested next steps from Simonsite:
- Confirm preferred commercial option (A/B/C).
- Provide full list of team owners and email addresses for key issuance.
- If you choose C, we will send an amendment PDF + redline and a DocuSign envelope.

I've attached a redline template (amendment_redline.docx) and flagged the pricing lines. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: amendment_redline.docx
